reason: Extend PentaTagger into GitHub-native semantic classification and restore the distinct PentaPR, PentaMerge, and PentaCloser authority chain without silently replacing protected workflow history.

changes.reason: Add immediate pull-request lifecycle events, optional exact PR targeting, actions read permission, and preserve the existing hourly PentaPR, PentaMerge, and PentaCloser schedule lanes.
Execute the selected lifecycle authority first, then project and read back GitHub-native PentaTagger labels so semantic tagging cannot overwrite or race the terminal lifecycle state.

authority_boundaries.PentaTagger: semantic classification and provider readback only
authority_boundaries.PentaPR: pull-request lifecycle classification and deadline state
authority_boundaries.PentaCloser: terminal close execution only after pre-close label readback

exclusions: No governance gate was disabled or weakened.
